name: sheet
title: Sheet 侧边面板
description: 在屏幕边缘的模态层或工作区侧栏中展示辅助内容。

whenToUse: 查看或编辑与当前页面相关的详细信息
accessibility: 工作区侧栏须提供区域名称
面板内按 Escape 可关闭并归焦
responsive: 模态面板在窄屏下占满或接近占满宽度
工作区侧栏可在窄屏排列到主内容下方

files.content:
# Sheet 设计规范

- 用 `Sheet.Panel` 展示可与工作区同时操作的详情或分析。使用 `label` 命名区域，让工具栏按钮通过 `aria-expanded` 和 `aria-controls` 表达开合和控制关系。窄屏可将侧栏排在主内容下方。
- `Sheet.Panel` 自带独立滚动区域。桌面保留 400 px 的布局宽度。焦点在面板内时可按 Escape 关闭，提供 `trigger` 时归还焦点。
- 用于从屏幕边缘滑出、与当前页面相关的辅助内容，如筛选条件、详情、设置；需要用户专注完成的流程用 Dialog，移动端可拖拽关闭的底部面板用 Drawer。
- 每个 `Sheet.Content` 都要有 `Sheet.Title`，不显示时加 `class="sr-only"`（检查规则 `valar/overlay-title`）。
- 方向只用 `side` 属性（`top`、`right`、`bottom`、`left`，默认 `right`），不要用 `class` 改定位。
- 左右面板的宽度、滑入距离、动效档位跟随组件默认值和组件参数；不要在 `Sheet.Content` 上写 `w-[...]`、`duration-*` 覆盖。
- `Sheet.Header`、`Sheet.Footer` 自带内边距；夹在中间的正文容器用与 Header 相同的横向内边距，并加 `flex-1 overflow-y-auto`，让长内容在面板内部滚动、Footer 留在底部。
- 打开它的按钮通过 `Sheet.Trigger` 的 `child` snippet 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）。
- 右上角关闭按钮的读屏文字默认是“关闭”，其他语言用 `Sheet.Content` 的 `closeLabel` 改。

<script lang="ts">
	import { DialogClose as SdkClose } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { ActionDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		type = "button",
		value,
		action,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "value"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		value?: string;
		action?: (event: Event | undefined, details: ActionDetails) => unknown;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkClose {type} {value} {action} data-slot="sheet-close" {...restProps}>
	{#snippet render({ props })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "sheet-close",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkClose>

{#if resolvedInline && trapFocus === false} {#if policyContext?.isOpen()}
{/if} {:else} {/if} {#snippet render({ props, state })}
{ (props.onkeydown as ((event: KeyboardEvent) => void) | undefined)?.(event); trapSheetTab(event); }} > {@render children?.()} {#if showCloseButton} {#snippet child({ props: closeProps })} {/snippet} {/if}
{/snippet}

{#snippet render({ props })}

{@render children?.()}

{/snippet}
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()}

{#snippet render({ props, state })}
{@render children?.()}
{/snippet}

{#if open}
{@render children?.()}
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}

{#snippet render({ props })}

{@render children?.()}

{/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		DialogTrigger as SdkTrigger,
		type DialogController,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		type = "button",
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		payload,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		children,
		child,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		payload?: unknown;
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{type}
	disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{payload}
	{shortcut}
	{controller}
	data-slot="sheet-trigger"
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "sheet-trigger",
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Dialog as SdkDialog,
		type DialogController,
		type DialogDismissAttemptDetails,
		type DialogOpenChangeDetails,
		type DialogPayloadChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/dialog";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { SHEET_POLICY_KEY, type SheetDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(false),
		defaultOpen,
		modal: modalProp,
		closeOnOutsidePress,
		presentation = "dialog",
		controller,
		dismissible,
		persistentElements,
		pendingAnnouncement,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "trap-focus";
		closeOnOutsidePress?: boolean;
		presentation?: "auto" | "dialog" | "sheet";
		controller?: DialogController<unknown, unknown>;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		persistentElements?: (Element | string)[] | (() => Element[]);
		pendingAnnouncement?: string;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: DialogOpenChangeDetails) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<DialogPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DialogDismissAttemptDetails) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<SheetDismissPolicy>({});
	const effectiveModal = $derived(
		modalProp !== undefined ? modalProp : policy.trapFocus === false ? false : true
	);
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);

	setContext(SHEET_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: SheetDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
		isOpen: () => Boolean(open),
		isModal: () => effectiveModal !== false,
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: DialogOpenChangeDetails) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				details.reason === "outside-press" &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkDialog
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={effectiveModal}
	{closeOnOutsidePress}
	{presentation}
	{controller}
	{dismissible}
	{persistentElements}
	{pendingAnnouncement}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkDialog>
